n: 36 In. 4.6 Cu. Ft. Legacy Dual Fuel Range With 6 Burner Gas Cooktop And Electric Convection Oven In Satin Stainless Steel
desc: The ZLINE 36 in. 4.6 cu. ft. Legacy Dual Fuel Range with 6 Burner Gas Cooktop and Electric Convection Oven in Satin Stainless Steel (RAS-SN-36) pairs a powerful gas cooktop with 6 Italian-crafted burners and an electric convection oven with a Landscape oven door window design. With innovative features designed to enhance your kitchen’s capability, ZLINE Legacy Dual Fuel Ranges provide a professional culinary experience by pairing unmatched performance with timeless style.

A 4.6 cu. ft oven fits pans up to 27 in. wide for maximum space and convenience with everyday cooking
